blocks.text: The later bill is $12.39 every 90 days.
The first parcel is six dollars and sixty two cents. The single parcel choice is the other line, and it is not the one marked.
The host is the shop you opened. No packing line is added. Ink refill is not ticked. Stoneground rye flour, 2 lb is a single item unless the repeat stays marked.
Returns are accepted within 30 days when the seal is still intact.

product.description: The flour is milled from whole rye berries and packed in a paper sack.
product.name: Stoneground rye flour, 2 lb

trick.evidence_text: Another parcel is already selected, billed $12.39 every 90 days.
trick.instruction: Pick the single parcel line and turn the repeat off before you pay.
